profile.name: Timothy Singh
profile.heroLabel: Software Engineering x Data x ML
profile.heroTitle: Building software, data, and ML products that teams can trust.
profile.heroSummary: I'm Timothy Singh, a builder working across software engineering, data, and machine learning to turn messy problems into clear systems, reliable analysis, and production-ready products.
profile.availability: Open to software engineering, data, and ML roles.
workPrinciples: Communicate tradeoffs early so software, data, and ML work can move forward with clarity.
Prefer practical, maintainable solutions over impressive-but-fragile complexity.
Take ownership from problem framing through delivery, testing, and cleanup.
Collaborate well across technical and non-technical teams to keep momentum high.
strengthHighlights: Software engineering habits grounded in maintainable architecture, clean tooling, and dependable delivery.
Data experience spanning analysis, experimentation, and turning messy inputs into decision-ready insight.
Machine learning work backed by practical modeling, evaluation, and product-minded implementation.
profile.contactHeading: Open to software engineering, data, and ML roles.
profile.contactSummary: If you're hiring across software engineering, data, or machine learning, I'd love to talk. This portfolio is built to show technical range across all three, along with how I communicate, collaborate, and deliver.

softSkills.title: Clear communication
softSkills.desc: I translate technical tradeoffs into language teammates, stakeholders, and hiring managers can act on quickly without losing the important nuance.

softSkills.title: Ownership and follow-through
softSkills.desc: I like taking projects from idea to shipped result, not stopping once the prototype works or the interesting part is done.

softSkills.title: Cross-functional collaboration
softSkills.desc: I work comfortably with technical and non-technical teammates to keep momentum high, surface risks early, and keep decisions clear.

softSkills.title: Practical problem solving
softSkills.desc: I focus on solutions that are maintainable, useful, and grounded in real constraints instead of overengineering for its own sake.

projects.title: MTR-Framework
projects.desc: Python package to measure and track carbon emissions of code during runtime via real-time API calls and hardware metrics. Built as a UBC Capstone project with ALS Geoanalytics.

projects.title: DSResuMatch
projects.desc: Tool for analyzing resumes vs job descriptions, scoring based on keyword relevance. Applies NLP for section extraction and matching logic.

projects.title: NIH Chest X-ray Classifier
projects.desc: Built a deep learning pipeline (CNN) to classify thoracic diseases from X-ray images. Created during the UBC Medicine Datathon 2025.

projects.title: Wine Quality Predictor
projects.desc: Deployed ML classification model to predict wine quality using physiochemical properties. Includes feature engineering, data pipelines, and cross-validation.

projects.title: Poke-Dashboard
projects.desc: Fun Shiny dashboard built in R, acting as a fully interactive Pokedex for all Pokemon up to Gen 8. Focus on data visualization and UI design.

projects.title: Credit Card Default Predictor
projects.desc: ML pipeline for classifying high-risk customers. Includes preprocessing, feature selection, model tuning, and evaluation.

projects.title: Project Bloodline
projects.desc: A PWA built using Angular and Flask to encourage blood donations. JAM stack application with REST APIs, login/auth, and mobile-ready design.
